name: std::wcscspn
intro: Returns the length of the maximum initial segment of the wide string pointed to by dest, that consists of only the characters not found in wide string pointed to by src.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
dest

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated wide string to be analyzed


 src

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated wide string that contains the characters to search for

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The length of the maximum initial segment that contains only characters not found in the character string pointed to by src.

examples.output:
The length of maximum initial segment is 3.
The segment is "\u767d\u732b ".

summary: Returns the length of the maximum initial segment of the wide string pointed to by dest, that consists of only the characters not found in wide string pointed to by src.
